The '''Solar Guard''' was a group based on the [[Corbett Cluster/Legends|Corbett Cluster]] during the years after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> 

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nick Rostu]] considered joining the Solar Guard rather than continue his mission of betraying former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="JT" />
